result_text:
A sub-landscape without a readable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. I confirmed the `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or generate a report with a missing config, so the fix itself is untested.

The change is in `LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`, in `addSubLandscapeRow`. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returns `null` when the file is missing or unreadable, and the old code then threw the NullPointerException on `getMetadata()`. It now falls back to an empty `Metadata` when the config or its metadata is `null`. Such a row is still rendered with its link to the index page and the default landscape logo. Rows whose sub-landscape has a config are unchanged and keep their own logo.
